en.<p class=\"eyebrow\">Ball Screw Support:
Ball Screw Support Bearings

Ball Screw Support Bearings

A single-direction thrust angular contact ball bearing with a contact angle of approximately 60°, offering high axial load support capacity while simultaneously withstanding a small amount of radial load.

Mainly used for ball screws and nuts in machine tools.

Available in a screw-fit type (ZKLF), a non-fit type (ZKLN), and angular contact types (7602·7603…TVP, TAC…B, BSB…T).

You can search by entering just part of the model number or dimensions.
